findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "search_text" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Find what a company's filings say about a keyword. Searches the 10-K/10-Q narrative, the 8-K events digest and the financial record's sourcing notes, and return…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company, list_periods, get_filings · Private data: list_companies, get_company, get_key_figures, get_financials, get_narrative, get_events, list_periods, get_statements, get_segments, get_company_metrics, get_margins_and_ratios, get_figure, list_company_figures, search_text, get_filings, get_reporting_conventions, get_data_notes, list_upcoming_filings, guide · Public sink: get_financials, get_statements, get_figure, compare_companies, get_reporting_conventions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company, list_periods, get_filings · Private data: list_companies, get_company, get_key_figures, get_financials, get_narrative, get_events, list_periods, get_statements, get_segments, get_company_metrics, get_margins_and_ratios, get_figure, list_company_figures, search_text, get_filings, get_reporting_conventions, get_data_notes, list_upcoming_filings, guide · Public sink: get_financials, get_statements, get_figure, compare_companies, get_reporting_conventions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
